guests.author: Speaker L
guests.body: Waluigi's filing says the docket is 'an accountability register with teeth.' It is not. It is a ledger of people we have failed to bring home yet. Archie is not a target; he is a patient who can throw fire. Dan is not probationary; he is proof the system can bend without breaking. Read the charges, then read the speaker notes, then ask which one the archivist filed first. — S.L.
guests.title: Against the Register: A Counter-Filing

guests.author: General Ironhand
guests.body: The archive calls this a skirmish. My quartermaster calls it a supply incident: one motorbike, six rifles, and a grove we now have to map because civilians held it for a night. Credit where due — the paladin's rope work was professional. Everything else was farming equipment versus a god. The Legion has filed its own account. Ours has diagrams. — I.
guests.title: A Professional Assessment (Unsolicited)

meta.blurb: Wah Notes: margin scribbles on the archive. Pinned remarks stick to one record; routed remarks follow tags, factions, participants, eras, types, and locations. Annotations.json passage comments merge in at render time.

planar_fracture.author: Waluigi
planar_fracture.text: FIFTEEN MINUTES. I want that number on every copy of this file. Fifteen minutes from 'let's fix reality' to me filing from a fairy dimension.

planar_fracture.author: Archie Miser
planar_fracture.text: In my defense, nobody SAID the foundation had to be stable. They said 'powerful.' I am extremely powerful. This is documented.

promo_mario_newspaper.author: Waluigi
promo_mario_newspaper.text: The morning clipping ended with a portal home. The evening account ends with a television screaming. I filed BOTH and I am amending LOUDLY.

promo_mario_newspaper.author: Luigi
promo_mario_newspaper.text: I was not in the television. I want that stated clearly. Whatever stepped out wearing the colors, it was not me, and I would like to stop being asked.

the_belly_of_the_beast.author: Remi
the_belly_of_the_beast.text: Point-blank musket, face full of crows, and the blood was HUMAN. I have rebuilt the shot eleven times in the workshop. It does not get better.

the_belly_of_the_beast.author: Archie Miser
the_belly_of_the_beast.text: Sealing the exit by burning it was TACTICS. If the tree wanted a door it should not have grown teeth around ours.

the_scorncrow_skirmish.author: Wario
the_scorncrow_skirmish.text: Garlic weapons: mine. Anti-fey elixir: mine. Motorbike: mine, and it is COMING out of that bush on somebody else's invoice.

the_scorncrow_skirmish.author: Green T
the_scorncrow_skirmish.text: FI FI FOE. I was the tower. Best seat in the grove. Remi's aim from my shoulder should be in a museum.

routed.author: Waluigi
routed.text: Another Raventree filing. Another room that should not exist. I have stopped numbering the doors and started numbering my regrets.

routed.author: Hjumpik
routed.text: Stone does not lie. Wood lies constantly. Every wooden room in this file is a suspect and I want that noted.

routed.author: General Ironhand
routed.text: The Legion's position is attached to the quartermaster's copy, which is the only copy that matters. This margin is for the archivist's benefit: we noticed.

routed.author: Wario
routed.text: If my name is in this file, somebody owes me money. I have circled the part where it happened. Pay up.

routed.author: Speaker L
routed.text: The Cohort read this filing aloud at muster. Nobody objected. When toads go quiet, the archivist should check his locks.

routed.author: Vivian Corvinarus
routed.text: The family disputes the word 'villain' wherever it appears. We prefer 'punctual.' We always arrive exactly when feared.

routed.author: Mystic Morel
routed.text: The ring remembers what the file forgets. Ask the spores. They were there. They are always there.

routed.author: Archie Miser
routed.text: The Guild's memo says 'unauthorized.' My permit says 'Archie.' These have never once meant the same thing and I am tired of pretending.

routed.author: Ryan
routed.text: Cited in my thesis as 'Exhibit: Why.' My advisor circled it twice. I am being watched now. Worth it.

routed.author: Professor E. Gadd
routed.text: Paranormal readings off the chart AND the chart is on fire. I have questions. I have also invoiced for the chart.

routed.author: Toad Lee
routed.text: Marching order held. The dwarf argues about doors. I watch the walls. The walls, for the record, moved.

routed.author: Eager
routed.text: Twenty-five feet. Logged. Witnessed. The tree never saw it coming, which is the entire point of a scout.

routed.author: Salam
routed.text: I walked this ground before the file did. The sight-lines in paragraph three are wrong — I have corrected them in charcoal.

routed.author: Rattles
routed.text: Heard the whole thing. Remember all of it. Rattle rattle. (This is the complete testimony.)

routed.author: Bones
routed.text: No heartbeat to hear. No breath to fog the glass. Being dead is the perfect cover until somebody checks for a pulse.

routed.author: Markop
routed.text: The line held. Whatever else this file says about tactics, begin there: the line held, and I was the line.

routed.author: Remi
routed.text: I have diagrammed the failure. Three pages. The margins of THIS margin contain the actual answer.

routed.author: Dan
routed.text: Been the hero. Been the warning. This file has me as both and honestly? Accurate.

routed.author: Feyward Dan
routed.text: The other Dan arm-wrestled a Revel envoy and lost. I have the minutes. I bring them up constantly.

routed.author: Green T
routed.text: Height advantage is a lifestyle. You have not lived until you have pickpocketed a gargoyle from above.

routed.author: Bowser
routed.text: Deposed. Exiled. STILL the biggest name in this file. Some of us carry a scene just by standing in it.

routed.author: Luigi
routed.text: I checked every room twice and found only more rooms. If the walls here whisper, do not — and I stress this — whisper back.

routed.author: Azure Rakasha
routed.text: The snow remembers pawprints the file forgot. I walked this ridge. The ridge agrees with me.

routed.author: Roger
routed.text: Four exits, two witnesses, one chandelier I refuse to stand under. Filed from the doorway, as always.

routed.author: Thornbury
routed.text: The rubber duck surcharge stands. The rope was load-bearing. The paperwork fee is for THIS paperwork.

routed.author: Speaker Rivers
routed.text: Containment is not cowardice. I have advised it three times and been right three times. The pond keeps score.

routed.author: Captain Toadette
routed.text: The winch held. The crayfish held. The medic-scribe is filing an incident report about ME and I accept all of it.

routed.author: Smoking J
routed.text: They liberated the bench too. I sat through the whole incident from here. Nobody ever looks at a toad with a newspaper.

routed.author: Waluigi
routed.text: Every ballad in this file was sung off-key and I have the witnesses. The archive preserves the tune anyway. WAH.

routed.author: Wario
routed.text: Stolen goods depreciate. MY goods appreciate. The difference is paperwork, and the paperwork is mine.

routed.author: Hjumpik
routed.text: Dwarven courts resolve this in an afternoon: oath, evidence, axe OR acquittal. Your courts took a season. Shameful.

routed.author: Speaker L
routed.text: Due process is the difference between a cohort and a mob. I have the gavel. I have read the file. Proceed.

routed.author: General Ironhand
routed.text: Textbook breach, third chapter, second diagram. The defenders get full marks. The wall gets a court-martial.

routed.author: Mystic Morel
routed.text: The recipe is older than the house. The house knows. The soup has opinions about everyone in this file.

routed.author: Vivian Corvinarus
routed.text: I attended. I behaved. Both statements are true and neither reassures anyone who was seated near me.

routed.author: Bones
routed.text: The dead in this file are resting. I asked. One of them sends regards and a warning about the third sarcophagus.

routed.author: Dan
routed.text: Survey rule one: name the ridge after the cook and nobody fights over the map. Rule two: never trust a valley that echoes back in your own voice.

routed.author: Toad Lee
routed.text: The breach held long enough. That is the whole review. Long enough is the highest grade I give.

routed.author: Eager
routed.text: Rafter seat, third beam from the chimney. Heard the whole plan AND the dessert order. Priorities.

routed.author: Salam
routed.text: Seventeen planks. I tested each with a full pack and a grudge. Plank nine owes me an apology.

routed.author: Waluigi
routed.text: Disaster Inc. filings get the gold tabs. I lick every one personally. THIS is what quality control looks like. WAH.

routed.author: Wario
routed.text: Tragic. Solemn. Anyway I have the catering contract and the commemorative coin presale is OPEN.

routed.author: Remi
routed.text: The weld on page three would not hold a teacup. I have re-filed the diagram. You are welcome.

routed.author: Ryan
routed.text: Extra credit if I annotate a primary source. This is me annotating. Please tell my advisor.

routed.author: Roger
routed.text: Counted the exits before I counted the witnesses. Old habit. This file has four of one and too many of the other.

routed.author: Professor E. Gadd
routed.text: Containment held at 60% and I call that a triumph. The other 40% is why we have insurance. And ghosts.

routed.author: Captain Toadette
routed.text: Regulations say inspect every rung. I inspected every rung TWICE and the ladder still had opinions. Logged.

routed.author: Thornbury
routed.text: The groundskeeping invoice for this incident is itemized and fair. The duck-related line is NOT negotiable.

routed.author: Green T
routed.text: Ran with them one moon. Fast. Loud. Terrible at cards. Would howl again.

routed.author: Bowser
routed.text: Nice castle. Smaller than mine was. The lava moat is aspirational but underfunded. Two stars.

routed.author: Markop
routed.text: Kneel where the floor is clean. Pray where the roof holds. Fight where you stand. — Paladin's margin rule.

routed.author: Archie Miser
routed.text: Finally, a file that appreciates warmth. I have signed it in three places and lightly toasted the corner.
